title: Communicatio n in Eastern Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Sort modes into traditional and modern, and into "reaches one person" and "reaches many".

skills.key_step: The child names traditional and modern modes of communication and says which reach many people.

floor.prerequisite: Names modern means of communication in Kenya.
floor.question: Name one modern means of communication.
floor.answer: any such as a mobile phone

representations: two sorts: traditional or modern; one person or many
steps: Sort it: one person or many.
contexts: a letter to a cousin in Kampala

board.say: Does it reach one person or many?

misconceptions.ask: Which is a traditional way of communicating?
Which mode reaches many people at once?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who hears a radio in a village.

misconceptions.ask: Is a phone call between two friends mass communication?
misconceptions.repair: Sort modes into one-to-one and one-to-many.

misconceptions.ask: Give one use of the internet for communication.
misconceptions.repair: Show an email and a news website.

checks.question: Give two modern modes of communication.
checks.answer: any two of: letters, telephone, radio, television, newspapers, mobile phones, internet

checks.question: Which mode reaches many people at once: radio or a letter?

skills.key_step: The child pairs communication challenges with solutions.

floor.question: Name a mode that reaches many people.

contexts: weak network in a remote area

board.do: Write no network, no electricity, vandalism.
Wait for solar or rural electrification.

misconceptions.ask: Why does lack of electricity harm communication?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how a phone is charged.

misconceptions.ask: What helps to stop theft of masts and cables?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which action stops a thief.

misconceptions.ask: Why do some families not use the internet?
misconceptions.repair: Compare the cost of data with the cost of a loaf of bread.

misconceptions.ask: A message says a school is closed, but it is not true. What problem is this?
misconceptions.repair: Check the message against the school's own notice.

checks.question: Which solution fits weak network in remote areas?
Which solution fits vandalism of cables?
